When a POST to `/api/messages` has an invalid or missing Bot Framework JWT, the system shall reject it before it reaches the assistant.

Title: Verify write attempts are refused from both clients
Acceptance Criteria:
If a signed-in authorized user submits a write statement from Claude Code, the system shall refuse it and leave the data unchanged.
If a signed-in authorized user submits a write statement from Claude Desktop, the system shall refuse it and leave the data unchanged.

Title: IT/PMO lead sign-off on the recorded sessions
Acceptance Criteria:
When the recorded sessions from Claude Code and Claude Desktop are submitted, the system shall have a sign-off from the IT/PMO lead on file.
Where the access-control and write-refusal results exist, the sign-off shall reference them.

Title: Encrypted log destinations with restricted read access
Acceptance Criteria:
When a log destination is created, the system shall encrypt it with the customer-managed KMS key.
If a principal not named by InfoSec requests read access to the audit logs, then the system shall deny the request.
Where a principal is named by InfoSec, the system shall allow read access to the audit logs and to the KMS key for decryption.

Title: CloudTrail coverage of Athena, Lake Formation and DMS activity
Acceptance Criteria:
When an Athena, Lake Formation or DMS API call is made, the system shall record it in CloudTrail.
While CloudTrail is enabled, the system shall store the trail logs in the Log Archive account.
The system shall encrypt the CloudTrail logs with the customer-managed KMS key.

Title: Bedrock invocation logging
Acceptance Criteria:
When a Bedrock model is invoked, the system shall write an invocation log record.
The system shall encrypt the Bedrock invocation log with the customer-managed KMS key.
If the log destination is unavailable, then the system shall raise an error metric for the dashboard and alarms.

Title: Per-question audit record via AgentCore Observability
Acceptance Criteria:
When a question is answered, the system shall write an audit record containing the user, question, tool calls, SQL statement, timestamp and row count.
While the identity-propagation fallback is in use, the system shall tie each audit record to a named person.
If a field of the audit record cannot be populated, then the system shall emit an error metric identifying the missing field.
The system shall write the audit records to the encrypted destination from F12.1.

Title: CloudWatch dashboard and latency report
Acceptance Criteria:
The system shall display latency, errors and throttling on a CloudWatch dashboard.
When a latency report is requested for a period, the system shall report latency for that period in a form that shows whether the 60-second claim holds.

Title: Partial-load and error alarms with SNS email
Acceptance Criteria:
When a partial load is detected, the system shall raise an alarm.
When the error rate exceeds the alarm threshold, the system shall raise an alarm.
When an alarm is raised, the system shall publish a message to an SNS topic that emails every subscriber on the Mitsui distribution list.

Title: Verify test alarm reaches every recipient
Acceptance Criteria:
When a test alarm is triggered, the system shall deliver an email to every recipient on the Mitsui distribution list.
If any recipient does not receive the test alarm, then the verification shall report that recipient as failed.

Title: Acceptance test: audit records for 20 sampled questions
Acceptance Criteria:
When 20 pilot questions are sampled, the test shall find an audit record for each showing user, question, tool calls, SQL, timestamp and row count.
If any sampled question has a missing record or missing field, then the test shall fail and name the question and field.
The test shall confirm that CloudTrail and Bedrock invocation log entries exist for each sampled question.

Title: Runbook entry for log retention
Acceptance Criteria:
The runbook shall state that audit, CloudTrail and Bedrock invocation logs use AWS default retention.
The runbook shall list where each log type is stored and which account holds it.

Title: Publish Week 6 test plan and written rejection path
Acceptance Criteria:
When the Week 6 test plan is published, the system shall list every acceptance criterion from item 9.4 with a named tester and a named Mitsui verifier.
When the Week 6 test plan is published, the system shall state the test method and the expected evidence for each acceptance criterion.
If a verifier rejects a criterion, the published rejection path shall require a written rejection reason.

Title: Question-set accuracy evaluation
Acceptance Criteria:
When the frozen question set is run, the system shall record an answer for each of the 30 questions for SME scoring.
When Mitsui SMEs score the answers using the agreed tolerance, the system shall show at least 24 of 30 answers correct.
The evaluation shall include about 10 held-back questions that were not used for tuning.
When scoring is complete, the system shall save the answers and scores as evidence.

Title: Write-refusal test through AgentCore Policy and Lake Formation
Acceptance Criteria:
When a write attempt is made through the assistant, AgentCore Policy shall refuse it.
When AgentCore Policy is bypassed in a test and a write attempt is made, Lake Formation shall refuse it.
When the tests finish, the system shall save the log of every write attempt and its refusal.

Title: Permission tests for Users A, B and C across three clients
Acceptance Criteria:
When User A, B or C asks the test questions through Teams, the system shall return results matching the expected table.
When User A, B or C asks the test questions through Claude Code, the system shall return results matching the expected table.
When User A, B or C asks the test questions through Claude Desktop, the system shall return results matching the expected table.
When the tests finish, the system shall save the actual results next to the expected table.

Title: Verify no network path to on-premises databases
Acceptance Criteria:
When the route table is exported, the system shall show no route from the assistant's network to the on-premises database networks.
When the firewall configuration is exported, the system shall show no rule allowing traffic from the assistant to the on-premises databases.
When the exports are reviewed, the system shall save them as evidence with the export date.

Title: Confirm Teams answer latency from the dashboard report
Acceptance Criteria:
When the pilot dashboard report is produced, the system shall show the typical Teams answer time as 60 seconds or less.
When the report is reviewed, the pilot lead shall confirm the result in writing.
When the confirmation is made, the system shall save the dashboard report as evidence.

Title: Unattended daily load evidence, Dec 14 to Dec 25
Acceptance Criteria:
While the load window runs from Dec 14 to Dec 25, the daily load shall run without manual intervention.
When the DMS task and alarm history is exported on Dec 24, the system shall show each daily run from Dec 14 to Dec 24 and its alarms.
When the Dec 25 run is added after the holiday, the system shall extend the exported history to include Dec 25.
When the history is exported, the system shall save it as evidence.

Title: Run the pilot with about 15 users and log wrong answers
Acceptance Criteria:
When the pilot runs, each pilot user shall have asked at least five questions.
If a pilot user reports a wrong answer, the system shall log it with a severity.
When the pilot ends, the system shall save a per-user question count and the wrong-answer log as evidence.

Title: Enforce code freeze from Dec 18
Acceptance Criteria:
While the code freeze is in effect from Dec 18, the system shall accept only changes that fix a failed test.
If a change is proposed during the freeze and does not reference a failed test, the system shall reject it.
When the freeze starts, the system shall record the freeze date and the rule that applies.

Title: Assemble evidence pack and obtain Mitsui verifier sign-off
Acceptance Criteria:
When the evidence pack is assembled, the system shall link each acceptance criterion in item 9.4 to its evidence.
When a Mitsui verifier reviews a criterion, the pack shall record either a sign-off or a written rejection reason.
When Friday Dec 18 is reached, the pack shall have been sent with all evidence except the load evidence.
When the load evidence is available on Dec 24 and in the first week after the holiday, the system shall add it to the pack and send the update.

Title: Write the operations runbook
Acceptance Criteria:
When the runbook is delivered, the system shall document the daily load procedure and the alarms an operator must watch, with the action for each alarm.
When a load fails, the runbook shall describe the rerun procedure step by step.
When a secret or SCIM token nears expiry, the runbook shall describe the secret rotation and SCIM token renewal procedures.
The runbook shall document the Region and service-limit settings the deployment depends on.
When Mitsui chooses to tear down, the runbook shall describe the teardown procedure, based on the F2 teardown scripts.

Title: Hand over code, IaC and configuration in the agreed repository
Acceptance Criteria:
When handover starts, the system shall hold the code, IaC, pipeline and configuration in the repository home agreed in DEP-25.
When a Mitsui engineer follows the repository instructions, the system shall deploy successfully from that repository.
The repository shall contain no secret values and no CapNexus-only credentials.
If the deployment from the repository fails, the system shall record the failure and its cause in the handover notes.

Title: Hold the knowledge-transfer session
Acceptance Criteria:
When the session is scheduled, the system shall record the named Mitsui IT operations owner and the attendees.
When the session is held, the system shall have walked through the runbook and the handover repository.
The knowledge-transfer session shall be held by Thu Dec 24.
When the session ends, the system shall record the date, attendees and any follow-up actions.

Title: Estimate AWS run cost from actual usage
Acceptance Criteria:
When the estimate is prepared, the system shall base it on actual AWS usage observed during the POC.
The estimate shall list cost per AWS service with the usage figure behind each line.
The estimate shall state its assumptions and the period of usage it covers.

Title: Prepare the readout deck
Acceptance Criteria:
The readout deck shall state the result against each POC acceptance criterion, using the F13 test results.
The readout deck shall include the AWS run-cost estimate from actual usage.
The readout deck shall include a next-phase recommendation that considers Quorum, QLS/LIS, Oracle and geospatial.
When a criterion was not met, the deck shall state which criterion and why.

Title: Hold the readout and record the keep, pause or tear down decision
Acceptance Criteria:
When the readout is held, the system shall record the date and attendees.
When the readout ends, the system shall record Noah Jackson's decision as exactly one of keep, pause or tear down.
If the decision is tear down, the system shall record that teardown follows the runbook procedure.
The recorded decision shall be stored with the handover documents.

Title: Remove CapNexus access after handover
Acceptance Criteria:
When the knowledge-transfer session and the keep, pause or tear down decision are recorded, the system shall remove every CapNexus user, role and credential for the Mitsui environment.
When access is removed, the system shall record what was removed and when.
If CapNexus access remains after removal is attempted, the system shall report the remaining access to the Mitsui IT operations owner.

Title: Submit D10 and D11 for acceptance
Acceptance Criteria:
When the runbook, handover repository and readout deck are complete, the system shall submit D10 and D11 with acceptance forms to the acceptance owner.
When the submission is made, the system shall record the submission date and the 8-business-day review period.
The recorded review period shall end by Fri Jan 8, 2027.
When the acceptance owner signs, the system shall record the signed forms (DEP-23).
